meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Signal 收发消息，就像使用手机上的 Signal 账号一样。
howto.when: 当用户完成设备链接（扫描二维码）并重启服务后，向绑定的 Signal 号码发送消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日程安排。
say.note: 通过 Signal 的“给自己发消息”功能发送，助手会回复。
助手会处理提醒并回复确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via Signal, using the same phone number as the linked device.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user sends a message to the linked Signal number after completing device linking and restarting the service.

say_en.note: Sent via Signal's Note to Self; the assistant will reply.

say_en.text: Remind me to have a meeting at 3 PM.
say_en.note: The assistant will process the reminder and confirm.
